items.text: Jalen Hurts (blood clots) is on IR; Tanner McKee starts (he threw every Eagles pass in Week 6). The schedule data still lists Hurts, so the model uses McKee.

Philadelphia final report: WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring), WR Dontayvion Wicks (ankle), OLB Nolan Smith (concussion) and DB Michael Carter (abdomen) are out. RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) is questionable after a full Saturday practice; Ian Rapoport expects him to play. OLB Jonathan Greenard (ankle) is a true game-time decision, and OLB Jalyx Hunt (knee/ankle) is questionable.

Monday: Philadelphia activated G Landon Dickerson and TEs Eli Stowers and Grant Calcaterra off IR and elevated RB Elijah Mitchell and OLB Keyshawn James-Newby. CB Jakorian Bennett was not activated, so he won't play.

Dallas final report: OT Drew Shelton (hamstring), WR/KR KaVontae Turpin (ribs) and LB Dee Winters (calf) are out. OLB Marist Liufau and S P.J. Locke are questionable and must be activated off IR. CB Cobie Durant and LB DeMarvion Overshown (pitch count) are trending toward playing. Dak Prescott starts.

adjust.reason: Philadelphia is without both DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks plus Nolan Smith, with Greenard a game-time decision, which outweighs Dallas losing Drew Shelton, Turpin and Winters even with Dickerson back. The stats model doesn't price non-QB injuries
